title: calanthe striata
intro: Calanthe striata, commonly known as the striated calanthe, is a species of orchid native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Calanthe striata are attributed to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are said to promote wound healing and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
